name: GameClockSystem
summary: Advances the EA's timing/clock object (EA+0x218) once per render frame: stores dt, accumulates total time, bumps a frame counter, then updates the clock's command-frame/time-scale state.
tick: clk=*(EA+0x218); clk+0x20=dt; clk+0x28(double)+=dt; clk+0x30=scaled int64 time; clk+0x38++ ; then FUN_7ff650ce63a0(clk,dt): converts dt to microsecond-ish ticks with a debug speed-up/slow-down modifier from flag byte clk+0xa8 (+/-200 or +/-1000), smooths two rate values at clk+0x80/+0x84 toward targets (clk+0x98*16000), and calls FUN_7ff65100e950(clk,ticks) to advance the CF clock.
interacts_with: EA clock object EA+0x218 (same object later read by CommandFrameSystem via +0x50 list of pending CFs)

key_functions.0x7ff650ce63a0: clock advance w/ time-scale flags, feeds CF accumulator

server_relevance: Needed conceptually (the server needs its own 16 ms clock), but this is the client's clock driver; server should implement its own tick clock rather than port this.
evidence: First system in game EA; only touches EA+0x218: writes dt at +0x20, accumulates double at +0x28, increments frame counter +0x38; 16000 constant (16 ms CF in us) in FUN_7ff650ce63a0.

name: MapLoadSystem (MapSystem)
summary: Map load/unload state machine. Holds current map id; walks a phase byte (sys+0x10: 2..8), requesting map resources and notifying all map-load listeners registered at EA+0x180 at each phase.
tick: switch(sys+0x10): 2 -> FUN_7ff650c194a0: resolve map asset (type 0x9e, id sys+0x18), request its load + preload several 0x6e (type 0x06E) resources, call listener slot1 (+8) 'begin', phase=3; 3/4/5/6 -> call listener slots +0x10/+0x18/+0x20/+0x28 on every listener and advance; 7 -> FUN_7ff650c195e0: listener slot +0x30 'load complete', release previous map resource (sys+0x20), phase=8 (loaded). States 3/4/5/7 are wrapped by gated helpers (c1a080 waits on resource ready via sys+0x53 flag, and calls world/scene object EA+0x130 vfunc+0x40(mapId)).
callbacks: OnInitialize (0x7ff650c17f90, not defined in Ghidra: 'mov byte [rcx+0x10],2; mov al,1; ret') sets phase=2 so loading starts immediately.
interacts_with: map-load listener list EA+0x180/0x188 (systems like MapRootEntitySystem implement slots 1..7)
resource manager (FUN_7ff6509a2d30 load request, FUN_7ff6509a5120/abac0 release)

key_functions.0x7ff650c194a0: phase 2: request map + prefetch, notify begin
key_functions.0x7ff650c195e0: phase 7: notify finished, release old map
key_functions.0x7ff650c1a080: phase-3 gate: wait for map resource, bind to world

server_relevance: Server must load the same map data (spawn map entities, collision), but the client listener fan-out/streaming is client-side; a server needs an equivalent map-load step, not this code.
evidence: Prometheus already names it MapSystem; phase byte 2..8, iteration over EA+0x180 listeners calling vfunc +8..+0x30 in order; map asset type 0x9e via FUN_7ff650828720(0x9e).

name: ProjectileTrackingBookkeepingSystem
summary: Per-frame bookkeeping on two singleton components (0x70 and 0x6f): registers entity ids of live projectile entities into a list on singleton 0x70, prunes 0x70 history entries older than the current command frame (from singleton 0x4d), and expires timed entity flag records after 700 ticks.
tick: FUN_7ff650d22320: for each component 0x27 (STUProjectileComponent) with byte +0x66 == 0, add owner entity id into unique int list at comp0x70+0x6e0. FUN_7ff650d22da0: remove 400-byte records from comp0x70+0x740 whose frame (+0x184) <= comp0x4d+0x18 (current CF); for each {entityRef,?,counter} in comp0x70+0x20 increment counter and when >700 clear flag 0x40 for that entity in comp0x6f+0x20 bucketed set (FUN_7ff651025330) and remove.
interacts_with: singleton 0x6f entity-flag hash (8 buckets by id&7)

key_functions.0x7ff650d22320: collect projectile entity ids into comp0x70+0x6e0
key_functions.0x7ff650d22da0: expire comp0x70 history (by CF) and 700-tick flag timers
key_functions.0x7ff651025330: clear flag bits on entity in comp0x6f set

server_relevance: Possibly relevant (projectile/hit history keyed by CF looks like lag-compensation/prediction bookkeeping), but singleton 0x70/0x6f semantics unconfirmed.
evidence: EA+0xb0 offsets 0xa80(0x70), 0x3a8(0x27), 0x738(0x4d), 0xa68(0x6f); compares record frame to comp0x4d+0x18 which CommandFrameSystem sets to the current CF; constant 700.

name: CommandFrameSystem
summary: The fixed-step driver: each render frame it pulls the list of pending 16 ms command frames from the EA clock and runs every registered command-frame listener (EA+0xf0) once per CF, maintaining a CF singleton (component 0x4d) with current CF number, time and phase.
tick: for all listeners in EA+0xf0: vfunc+8 (PreCommandFrames); comp0x4d+0x28=1; pending=clock(EA+0x218)+0x50 int list; FUN_7ff650feea30(sys, first, last): for cf in [first..last]: comp0x4d+0x18=cf, comp0x4d+0x20=cf*16 (ms), FUN_7ff650fef420(EA,cf,flags{1=first,2=last}) which calls every listener vfunc0 OnCommandFrame(cf,flags) and prunes EA+0x110 deferred entries older than cf; wraps the loop with EA->vfunc0x70()->vfunc0x20() 'simulating' flag (+0x18) and a post call FUN_7ff65101fc30; then comp0x4d+0x28=2 and listener vfunc+0x10 (PostCommandFrames).
interacts_with: EA clock EA+0x218 (+0x50 pending CF list)
command-frame listener list EA+0xf0 (e.g. WeaponCommandFrameSystem, UnsynchronizedMover-type listeners at system+0x10 subobjects)

key_functions.0x7ff650feea30: run CF range, set comp0x4d CF/time
key_functions.0x7ff650fef420: per-CF: call all EA+0xf0 listeners vfunc0(cf,flags); prune EA+0x110

server_relevance: Core: server needs the same CF loop (listener fan-out per 16 ms CF) to run the simulation deterministically in step with clients.
evidence: Loop sets comp0x4d+0x18=cf and +0x20=cf*16000/1000; calls vfunc0(cf, first|last<<1) on EA+0xf0 list; phase markers 1/2 in comp0x4d+0x28.

name: WeaponAttachmentCommandFrameSystem
summary: No OnTick; it is a command-frame listener (subobject at sys+0x10, vtable RVA 0x15c1ef8, slot0 = 0x7ff650c133a0). Each CF it iterates weapon components and updates per-weapon muzzle/attachment transforms from the owner's movement state and model.
callbacks: OnCommandFrame(cf) 0x7ff650c133a0: for each component 0x26 (STUWeaponComponent): check entity component 0x3b and FUN_7ff650c3e8e0(EA,entity) (locally controlled?); owner = FUN_7ff650ffc460; get owner movement state (0x12) vfunc+0x40(cf) and, if state flag 0x40000 at +0x198, iterate its array at +0xd8; for each slot resolve the weapon's sub-object via FUN_7ff651021310, compute a transform from the model (0x04, FUN_7ff651021510 bone/attachment lookup) or fall back to movement state +0xa060, write +0x20/+0x28 and FUN_7ff651023980.
server_relevance: Likely relevant for server-side hit/projectile origin if server simulates weapons; otherwise client-visual. Unconfirmed.
evidence: Live instance 0x3e94160 has +0x10 vtable 0x1415c1ef8 whose slot0 is 0x140c333a0; that function iterates EA+0xb0+0x390 (component 0x26) and reads movement state at the passed CF.

name: UIWidgetUpdateSystem
summary: Runs in game, session and lobby EAs. Walks the EA's UI screen/widget tree (EA vfunc 0xf0), re-evaluates widget visibility/enabled, shows/hides widgets, evaluates data bindings and triggers per-widget updates.
tick: g_uiDepth++; ui = EA->vfunc(0xf0); FUN_7ff650c10fc0: recursively evaluate every root widget (vfuncs 0x298 IsVisible / 0x2a0 IsEnabled, +0x384/+0x385 cached flags), collect newly shown/hidden lists at sys+0x10/+0x28, call widget vfunc 0x258 (show) / 0x260 (hide) and set dirty bit in ui+0x78 byte array; FUN_7ff650c11e30: for widgets with bits 1|2 re-evaluate bindings (FUN_7ff650c11a30: iterate binding list, evaluate variant values types 2/4/5, diff against cached values +0x48 map, queue changed keys at +0x320); FUN_7ff650c121c0: for dirty widgets push changed binding values and call the widget's update vfunc, flush global UI batch (DAT_7ff651887070).
interacts_with: EA type check against PTR 0x7ff6517991e8 (+0x249 flag hides all UI)
server_relevance: UI only - not needed on server.
evidence: Objects with huge vtables (0x258/0x260/0x268/0x298/0x2a0/0x2b0), child lists with per-child visible flag, binding values with variant type tags; present in all three EAs including lobby.

name: MovementImpactEffectSystem
summary: For entities with component 0x18, detects when their movement state advances (new state index) and raycasts from the previous to the current position (with character eye/crouch height offset), spawning an impact effect and a decal at the hit; large jumps additionally poke the scene node.
tick: Collect all component 0x18 instances, sort; for each: movement state 0x12 current index (+0x430 ring) vs cached comp+0x18; if changed, get previous/current states (vfunc+0x40), positions +0x220/+0x230 transformed by parent; add CharacterMover (0x15) height (+0x2d0 or crouched +0x2dc); scene comp 0x01 -> +0x198 node: FUN_7ff650c8aa10 (physics raycast FUN_7ff6509d76c0 with team mask from component 0x10, lookup impact effect by material hash, spawn effect entity) and FUN_7ff650c8aef0 (raycast, append 0x110-byte decal record to singleton list FUN_7ff650c36380(EA)); if displacement^2 >= threshold call FUN_7ff6509da780(node,pos). Max 2 per frame.
evidence: EA+0xb0+0x240 = component 0x18; mask bits 0x12/0x15/0x01 lookups; raycast then effect/decal record creation with normal·direction intensity.

name: MapRootEntitySystem
summary: No OnTick; implements the map-load listener interface (subobject sys+0x10, vtable RVA 0x15c19f0). When the map finishes loading it creates a bare entity and registers it with the EA's world/scene object, storing its id at EA+0x238; on map unload it deletes that entity.
callbacks: MapLoadListener slot6 (+0x30, map load complete) 0x7ff650bf48a0: build empty entity-creation info (FUN_7ff6509b4c10), create entity FUN_7ff6507ef7c0(EA, nullGUID, info), world=*(EA+0x130)->vfunc0(), FUN_7ff6509d2290(world, entity), EA+0x238 = entity id. Slot7 (+0x38, unload) 0x7ff650bf49b0: delete entity EA+0x238, reset to -1.

key_functions.0x7ff650bf48a0: on map loaded: create root entity, attach to world

server_relevance: Unclear; likely client scene plumbing (world root/sky/ambient entity).
evidence: Live instance 0x3e94200 has +0x10 vtable 0x1415c19f0 whose only non-default slots are 6 and 7; MapLoadSystem calls listener slots in phase order ending at +0x30.

name: FirstPersonRenderFlagSystem
summary: Per local-player component (0x2f): clears last frame's first-person render flags, then sets scene render flags (0x800 always, 0x400 conditional) on the currently viewed entity, its first-person/viewmodel entity (component 0x22 +0x20), and when viewing yourself on attached child entities.
tick: For each component 0x2f: for ids in comp+0x1530 list clear scene (0x01) flags 0x800/0x400 via FUN_7ff6509c5b70, reset list; view=FUN_7ff650cd3f40(comp); if component 0x22 on view -> viewmodel entity +0x20 gets flags (per comp+0x15d1); view gets flags (0x400 unless comp+0x15d0); if view==own entity (cd4840) also iterate a child-entity id list from component 0x3e and flag them; record ids into comp+0x1530.
evidence: EA+0xb0+0x468 = component 0x2f; mask bit 1 (scene comp) flags 0x400/0x800 toggled; bit 0x22 = STUFirstPersonComponent.

name: ReplayTransferReceiveSystem (kill-cam data)
summary: Game-EA-only system with no OnTick; it owns a 'TransferBlockPool' and implements a network-message handler interface (sys+0x10, vtable RVA 0x15c3df8) that receives chunked transfer blocks (16-bit stream id + length-prefixed payload) and a per-update hook that hands completed streams to the replay/kill-cam manager (DAT_7ff651797fc0).
callbacks: iface slot0 (thunk 0x140c73ec0 -> 0x7ff650c534f0): if replay manager state (+0x104)==2 reset playback (FUN_7ff650c63300) and set state 3; for every stream in the block map feed its blocks into sys+0x60 (FUN_7ff650b7f250 stream assembler), clear map. iface slot6 0x7ff650c53ed0: parse message: short id, short seq(+0x400), short len(+0x402), copy payload into a pooled block (CRITICAL_SECTION sys+0x80), insert into map keyed by id (FUN_7ff650c54650).
interacts_with: network message dispatch (handler table xrefs at 0x7ff65166e1b8/0x7ff65166e210)
server_relevance: Server-side counterpart needed only if kill-cam/replays are supported (server must send these transfer blocks); otherwise optional.
evidence: String 'TransferBlockPool' in ctor; handler referenced from message tables; replay manager object at DAT_7ff651797fc0 also used by the session-only ReplayControlSystem.

name: LobbyBackgroundSceneSystem
summary: Lobby EA system 0: ticks the embedded 3D scene EA used by the lobby/title screen (found via lobby-map component 0x54) and updates its world, and maintains a GUID->entity-id map for component 0x06 entities.
tick: c = first component 0x54 of client EA DAT_7ff651813e18; if c+0x28 (nested EntityAdmin) -> EntityAdmin::Tick(nested, dt) (FUN_7ff6507f15d0); if c+0x18 (world) -> FUN_7ff6509d6770(world, dt, paused = world+0x3a8+0x160==4).
callbacks: OnInitialize 0x7ff65102e650: allocates helper object (FUN_7ff65100f630, 0xaa50-byte inner object) bound to the EA, stored at sys+0x70; PreDelete frees it. OnEntityAdded (subscribed to 0x06) 0x7ff65102eaf0: read GUID of the component-0x06 entity and store entity id in map sys+0x48.

key_functions.0x7ff6507f15d0: EntityAdmin::Tick (increments EA+0xC8, calls each system vfunc 0x68)

evidence: FUN_7ff6507f15d0 is the generic EA tick (iterates systems calling vtable+0x68); called on component 0x54 +0x28; lobby-only membership.

name: ChatVoiceChannelSystem
summary: Lobby system that ticks the chat singleton (component 0x5f) and, on a throttled timer, joins/leaves the party (type 4) and team/match (type 5) chat/voice channels, posting a localized notice that includes the push-to-talk key binding.
tick: chat=comp 0x5f; FUN_7ff650cbbc10(chat,dt) (chat UI/message processing), FUN_7ff650cbdcc0(chat); resolve pending state sys+0x14; every N seconds FUN_7ff650c5a8a0: look up channel of type 4 matching current party (FUN_7ff650c27500) or type 5, compare with stored names sys+0x18/+0x38, leave old / join new via FUN_7ff650d2f860(DAT_7ff651813e18+0x188 ...), then FUN_7ff650c5a380 builds localized strings (0xde... string GUIDs, key bindings 0xa9/0xa2) and posts to chat.
callbacks: PreDelete 0x7ff650c595d0: leave both channels (FUN_7ff650c5a300 on sys+0x18 and sys+0x38).

key_functions.0x7ff650c5a380: post localized join notice w/ key bind

server_relevance: Not needed for match serving (social/chat); a lobby/chat backend could matter only if chat is emulated.
evidence: Singleton EA+0xb0+0x8e8 (0x5f) with channel list +0x68 typed 4/5, string compares on channel names, join via +0x188 service, key-binding ids in the notice.

name: WebContentDownloadSystem
summary: Lobby system that completes asynchronous HTTP downloads done on a worker thread: drains the global completed-request list each frame and parses the (optionally zlib-compressed, cached) XML payload into entries of a lobby singleton (component 0x61).
tick: OnTick (thunk 0x140c15a40 -> 0x7ff650bf84e0): under spinlock DAT_7ff65188c834 take completed list DAT_7ff65188c868, for each request FUN_7ff650bf85a0: find entry in comp0x61+0xf0 map by request key, if state 2 parse payload with XML parser (FUN_7ff650e46900, element callbacks handle 'Locale'/'locale','id' tags) -> state 3 on success / 4 on failure, then free request.
callbacks: PreDelete 0x7ff650bf5a50: cancel pending (FUN_7ff650bf7d30, waits on worker thread handle DAT_7ff651813e10) and free all queued requests (FUN_7ff650bf86a0).
interacts_with: worker thread FUN_7ff650bf7e40 -> FUN_7ff650bf7f90 (HTTP GET, status 200 check, cache DAT_7ff651813de8, zlib 1.2.8 'ZpmC' header)

key_functions.0x7ff650bf85a0: parse downloaded XML into comp0x61 entry

server_relevance: Not needed (client web content such as news/localized feeds).
evidence: HTTP status 200 check, zlib version string '1.2.8', XOR-obfuscated tag strings decode to 'locale'/'Locale'/'id', worker-thread handle wait in PreDelete.

name: AssetPrefetchSystem
summary: Lobby system that decides which hero/player assets to stream and at what priority, diffing the desired set against the currently held set in a singleton list, issuing load requests for new ones and releasing ones no longer wanted; component 0x76 holds asset references that are released when the component is removed.
tick: Rebuild desired list at sys+0x10 (FUN_7ff650be5ff0: for each component 0x3f player entity, pick its hero/skin asset from its component (+0xb0) with recency test on clock time, priority 5 (6 if relevant to local player via FUN_7ff650ffd2b0, 4 if within distance of the camera entity) plus extra asset FUN_7ff650cde240 at priority 6; FUN_7ff650be7430 adds more). Then against held list FUN_7ff650c2a110(EA)+0x18: release entries not desired (FUN_7ff6509a5120/abac0/4890), raise priority on existing ones (FUN_7ff6509a2d30/3210), request new ones.
callbacks: OnEntityRemoved (subscribed 0x76) 0x7ff650be64c0: release every asset reference stored in the entity's component 0x76 list and clear it.

key_functions.0x7ff650be4f30: OnTick: diff desired vs held assets
key_functions.0x7ff650be5ff0: build prioritized desired asset list from players

evidence: Resource request calls with priority args 4/5/6; diff/release loop; component 0x76 lookup via second mask word (+0xa0 bit 0x36).

name: ReplayControlSystem
summary: The one session-EA-only system: debug/user controls for replay (kill-cam/highlight) playback. When the replay manager is active it reads input actions and toggles pause, restarts/seeks playback at a time, and cycles the spectated player.
tick: if DAT_7ff651797fd0 state == 7: input=FUN_7ff650c2ae30(); on action 0x37b toggle replayMgr+0x40189 (pause); 0x37d adjust time (+0x114/+0x4016c); 0x37c restart at current time (FUN_7ff650c638d0 = re-create replay at time with stored names); 0x380/0x381 next/previous spectate target (FUN_7ff650c56e80 -> c558b0/c55850); 0x2ef set replayMgr+0x4018c=1 (exit).
evidence: Only in session EA (index 39); operates on DAT_7ff651797fc0 which FUN_7ff650c63300 resets (tears down replay session and its map).
